tasks.label: Upload & Run Robot Interactive
tasks.command: ssh robot@ev3dev.local 'mkdir -p /home/robot/robotics'; if ($?) { scp main.py robot@ev3dev.local:/home/robot/robotics/ }; if ($?) { ssh -t robot@ev3dev.local 'chmod +x /home/robot/robotics/main.py && brickrun -r -- pybricks-micropython /home/robot/robotics/main.py' }
